item.title: Studies of Auditing "On-the-Ground" in the Majority World
item.content:encoded:
This special issue invites submissions that provide on-the-ground empirical studies of auditing practices, processes, and institutions in the Majority World countries. We welcome research that examines auditing as it is actually practiced in real-world contexts, moving beyond theoretical frameworks to understand the lived experiences of auditors, audit clients, regulators, and other stakeholders.

Timeline

  • December 31, 2027: Full paper submission deadline

item.title: Literature Reviews Exploring Accounting, Auditing, and Taxation – An International Perspective
item.content:encoded:
This special issue of the Journal of International Accounting, Auditing and Taxation welcomes literature reviews that explore accounting, auditing, and taxation from an international perspective.

Timeline

  • June 30, 2026: Submission deadline
